LanguageData.Raven_Building_ConveyorInputPort.label: (Raven) Conveyor Input Port
LanguageData.Raven_Building_ConveyorInputPort.descrip: Placed over a conveyor and facing the target, it sends virtual items from the conveyor into a drone chest or Raven industrial machine.
LanguageData.Raven_Building_ConveyorOutputPort.label: (Raven) Conveyor Output Port
LanguageData.Raven_Building_ConveyorOutputPort.descri: Placed over a conveyor and facing the target, it pulls virtual items from a drone chest or Raven industrial machine and sends them onto the conveyor.
